verdicts.evidence: The three blue bars in the left panel sit on a bare baseline, with no value axis, units, bar labels or date range anywhere in the chart.
The title says only "Rainfall at the reservoir" and there is no caption under the chart, so nothing tells the visitor what the rainfall means for them.
"Getting there" starts level with the top of the chart frame, about 64 px to its right, and sits under the one page title "Rainfall at the reservoir" with no separate heading for the page.
